statement: Pinned SDL's Xbox One HIDAPI backend distinguishes an older Xbox One S firmware 3.1.1221 state report of 16 bytes with a separate Guide report from 17-byte firmware 4.8.1923 and 5.x state handling with Guide position differences. Its Bluetooth fallback dispatches input report 0x01 for state, 0x02 for Guide and 0x04 for battery, while a successful Linux HID descriptor parse can select descriptor-driven decoding instead.

applicability.revision: Xbox One S Bluetooth firmware-specific consumer paths, not an invariant native packet claim
applicability.firmware: 3.1.1221, 4.8.1923 and 5.x examples from SDL source; not independently measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:408-459,1257-1311,1377-1459,1955-1998; the 17-byte format and report IDs are conditional decoder expectations.
